Construct an intervention object

Source: R/interventions.R
make_intervention.Rd

Defines a single intervention that can be installed into one or more settings via set_intervention_ach(). The intervention's effect on per-location ventilation is encoded by delta_function, which returns the extra equivalent ACH (eACH) the intervention adds to each covered location. The function can either return a constant (same delta for every covered location) or a value that depends on the location's baseline ACH. Optional unit-to-unit variation can be added via variation.

Usage

make_intervention(
  name,
  delta_depends_on_baseline_ach = FALSE,
  delta_function = NULL,
  delta_params = list(),
  variation = FALSE,
  variation_params = list(),
  coverage = NULL
)

Arguments

name

A character string label for the intervention.

delta_depends_on_baseline_ach

Logical. If FALSE (default), delta_function is called with no arguments — the same delta is applied to every covered location. If TRUE, delta_function is called with the location's baseline ACH as its first argument — delta varies per location.

delta_function

A function returning the eACH that the intervention adds. When delta_depends_on_baseline_ach = FALSE, delta_function should take no arguments other than those in delta_params. When delta_depends_on_baseline_ach = TRUE, the first argument must be the baseline ACH. Required (must not be NULL).

delta_params

A named list of additional arguments passed to delta_function. Default = list().

variation

Logical. If TRUE, each location's delta is multiplied by an independent lognormal draw with mean 1, so that unit-to-unit variation does not shift the mean delta. Default = FALSE.

variation_params

A named list supplying sdlog, the standard deviation on the log scale of the lognormal multiplier (dimensionless; approximately the relative error for small values). Required when variation = TRUE. Default = list().

coverage

Numeric in [0, 1]. Fraction of total setting size to cover when the intervention is installed.

Value

A named list with the seven fields above, used as the intervention object used by set_intervention_ach() and the downstream pipeline.

See also
